# ClozFlow

> Autonomous AI voice telephony and sales copilot platform.

ClozFlow is an intelligent autonomous AI voice sales employee and copilot platform. It dials inbound and website leads in 25 seconds, answers customer calls on ring one, speaks fluent Hindi and English naturally, and schedules meetings directly onto your CRM calendar.

## Key Capabilities

- [Voice Telephony](https://clozflow.in/#how-it-works): Autonomous inbound and outbound phone calling with dedicated virtual lines.
- [Behavioral Intelligence](https://clozflow.in/#features): Real-time objection detection and live negotiation assistance.
- [Integrations](https://clozflow.in/#integrations): Direct CRM synchronization with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Webhooks.
- [Pricing](https://clozflow.in/pricing): Flexible pricing tiers starting with instant setup.
